{"comment": "Overall the instructions were clear and the payoff structure made the social dilemma easy to understand. Anonymity and lack of communication limited reciprocity and punishment, so cooperation stayed at a middling level. Suggestions: (1) consider varying the multiplier or group size to test sensitivity to marginal per-capita return, (2) allow limited communication or reputation information in some conditions to see effects on cooperation, and (3) report individual contributions (or anonymized histories) to study reciprocity dynamics.
